note: The official credit card listing at /cards/creditcards has three category sliders (Travel, Cashback, Rewards). Each consumer credit card is one li.splide__slide in those three blocks (15 cards). Debit, prepaid, recommended-service, and Cards Promos slides on the same page are outside these blocks and are not card items. The EveryDay Titanium Mastercard tile links to /creditcards/everyday-titanium-mastercard (no /cards prefix). Do not treat sitemap URLs with numeric suffixes (platinum-mastercard-1 and similar) or eastwest-jcb-reward as extra listing tiles; they are not in these sliders.
